name: Rapides Parish, LA
findings: Rapides Parish has 370 nonprofit organizations. 126 of them (34%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 106 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Rapides Parish has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
